description: Make a design decision without anchoring: independent option generators (and a threat modeler at high risk) in parallel, the architect decides and records it, then critics with evidence: God Eye cold, and the API-conformance critic against the pinned dependency source when the job has one. Their serious items go to finding verifiers; the architect revises while open items shrink (always once after the last critique), up to a ceiling; every stop goes to the human gate with the open objections shown.

fanout.prior: the smallest change that meets every criterion
the most robust design for the next two years
the design closest to patterns already in this repository
